name: Recharge Innate Magic
body:
Source Advanced Race Guide pg. 39
School transmutation; Level alchemist 1, arcanist 1, bard 1, cleric 1, druid 1, hunter 1, inquisitor 1, investigator 1, magus 1, mesmerist 1, oracle 1, psychic 1, redmantisassassin 1, skald 1, sorcerer 1, warpriest 1, witch 1, wizard 1 (gnome)
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Effect
Range personal
Target you
Duration instantaneous
Description
You channel magic energy into your own aura, recharging your innate magic abilities. You regain one use of all 0-level and 1st-level spell-like abilities you can use as a result of a racial trait.
